sn51.4:1.1: bhikkhave iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abbhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti ||
sn51.4:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipadaṃ bhāveti
sn51.4:1.7: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī
